name: 剑宗
desc: 以剑入道，攻伐为先。弟子剑意凌厉，攻势凶猛。
descEn: The path of the sword, offense above all. Disciples wield razor-sharp sword intent.

name: 丹宗
desc: 炼丹悟药，续命为本。弟子气血充沛，灵力绵长。
descEn: Masters of pill refinement and longevity. Disciples enjoy robust vitality.

name: 符宗
desc: 画符布阵，万法归宗。弟子防御稳固，气运亨通。
descEn: Talisman crafting and formation mastery. Disciples gain solid defense and fortune.
